Class ScatterPlot3D

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.mdi3D.item3D.Item3D
edu.cnu.mdi.mdi3D.item3D.ScatterPlot3D
public class ScatterPlot3D extends Item3D
A thread-safe 3D scatter plot for use on a Panel3D.

Overview

ScatterPlot3D renders a collection of colored spheres as a scatter plot inside a dynamic wireframe bounding box. The bounding box starts at a caller-supplied initial size and grows automatically as new data points are added.

Threading

add(float, float, float, float) and add(float, float, float, Color) are safe to call from any thread, including high-frequency producer threads. Each call atomically expands the bounding-box bounds and enqueues the new sphere. A repaint is then requested on the EDT via a coalescing gate: no matter how many add() calls arrive between two EDT ticks, at most one repaint() is scheduled. This prevents EDT flooding during a data storm while ensuring the display stays live.

Throttling

An optional minimum repaint interval (setThrottleMs(long), default 50 ms ≈ 20 fps) further limits refresh rate under extreme load. Set to 0 to repaint as fast as the EDT can process.

Color Mapping

Use add(float, float, float, float) with a scalar value in [0, 1] to get automatic scientific coloring. The default map is ScientificColorMap.VIRIDIS, but any MDI scientific color map can be selected with setColorMap(ScientificColorMap). You can also supply an explicit Color via add(float, float, float, Color).

Usage

// Create the plot and add it to the panel
ScatterPlot3D scatter = new ScatterPlot3D(panel,
        -1f, 1f,   // X range
        -1f, 1f,   // Y range
        -1f, 1f);  // Z range
panel.addItem(scatter);
panel.softRefresh();

// From any thread — safe during a data storm
scatter.add(x, y, z, normalizedValue);   // 0..1 → heat-map color
scatter.add(x, y, z, Color.CYAN);        // explicit color

// Tune the refresh rate
scatter.setThrottleMs(16);   // ~60 fps cap
scatter.setPointRadius(0.02f);

      public void setAxisLabels(String xLabel, String yLabel, String zLabel)

      zLabel - z-axis title

    • setBoundsListener

      public void setBoundsListener(ScatterPlot3D.BoundsListener listener)
      Register a listener that is called on the EDT whenever the bounding box expands. The float array passed to the listener is [minX, maxX, minY, maxY, minZ, maxZ].

      Multiple expansions that arrive between EDT ticks are coalesced into a single callback carrying the latest bounds at that moment. Pass null to remove the listener.

      Parameters:
      listener - the bounds listener, or null
